verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents core building blocks (virtual card creation, transaction rules to approve/decline, real-time authorization webhooks) that could technically support scoped agent cards, but nowhere does the evidence name AI agents or an agent-specific use case, nor explicitly detail merchant-lock or expiry configuration on a paymentInstrument. missing for 10: vendor naming of AI-agent use case, explicit merchant-lock and amount-cap rule examples, explicit card expiry-setting documentation, independent corroboration of agent-issuing in practice.
